leftEvidence.title: Wisdom is a tree of life to those who hold her

points.label: Holding fast
points.left: Those who lay hold of wisdom are happy.
points.right: Those who hold wisdom fast will live.

points.label: Leaving
points.left: The saying praises retaining wisdom without naming the result of leaving her.
points.right: Those who forsake wisdom will die.

points.label: Identity
points.left: Wisdom is called a tree of life.
points.right: Wisdom is identified as the book of God’s commandments without being called a tree.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving their participants, setting, sequence, genre, and inference boundaries.

rightEvidence.title: Those who hold wisdom fast will live

payload.tension: Proverbs gives wisdom the tree-of-life image; Baruch carries the holding-and-life relation into a commandment setting without repeating the image.
payload.title: Wisdom held fast as the way to life
